body.en: The source page divides this subject at “History”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Part type on the page is an S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit. Unit: set. The φ220 large-end row is the one that mentions six-piece kits. This φ210 row does not. Material is a missing field. Service life is a missing field. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The S-tube seal page does not point to Electric 20, HBT8018, LZ-60 or any other model slug. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write S-tube large-end seal, φ210, and the quantity in sets. For φ220, say whether the six-piece kit is the row you checked on the machine. For other large-end sizes, do not add a six-piece count. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
